Under the maintainer-2026-07-28 rule, Park Head approval + operator completion already own relocation/count; verifier approval cannot move or roll back census truth. A pre-000049 authorized+completed row may be lazily applied once for rollout compatibility.

Filters source.module=milk_preparation + ref_type=milk_preparation_completion. APPROVE is the only transition from pending_verification to completed for the farm-day preparation; the operator's two/five-video submit never completes it. NO FEED-STOCK FAN-OUT, deliberately (maintainer decision 2026-08-27, migration 000216; the 2026-08-22 recorder seam was removed 2026-09-02). UHT Milk stock depletes from the preparation itself, on SUBMIT, through the feed_effective_external_consumption view, which reads milk_preparation_completions directly. The retired countsapp.MilkPreparationUHTRecorder seam wrote a SECOND row into feed_external_consumption on approve, keyed at preparation_date while the view books the same milk at feeding_date (= preparation_date + 1, a DB CHECK), so the ledger row was never suppressed by its own preparation and the litres were deducted twice on any day whose previous day carried no preparation. Migration 000241 additionally suppresses a ledger row on EITHER of a preparation's dates. Pinned by TestKernelStory_UhtMilkStockDepletesOnce.

Filters source.module=milk_feeding + ref_type=milk_feeding_completion. APPROVE completes exactly one farm x feeding_date x session task and applies that accepted session's watchlist answers; two consecutive accepted Yes answers graduate a kid, while No resets the streak.

FeedDistributionVerificationHandler.HandleEvent filters source.module=feed + source.ref_type=feed_distribution_completion and calls DistributionCompletionStore.ApplyVerifiedDistribution, which flips the feed_distribution_completions row 'pending_verification' -> 'completed' and emits feed.distribution.completed. DeathVerificationHandler filters source.module=counts + ref_type=workflow_death_signoff and closes the death review gate. BirthVerificationHandler filters ref_type=workflow_birth_signoff, whose ref_id is one mother or child workflow_id, and closes only that subject's gate. Death carries two proofs; each Birth item carries only its workflow's task-proof bundle. Keys include workflow, review round, and proof refs so retries deduplicate and re-shoots create a fresh item.

VerificationVerdictHandler filters source.module=weighing + source.ref_type in (weighing_observation, weighing_shed_observation) and calls weighingpg.ApplyVerificationVerdict, the SINGLE writer of the verdict's effect on the observation (approved -> verification_status='verified'; rework -> 'rework', slot withdrawn, bucket + work items reactivated). Idempotent on the verification event id. APPLY-RECEIPT (W-18): after that transaction commits the handler calls verification MarkVerdictApplied via weighing/adapters/verificationbridge, stamping verification_items.applied_at/applied_by_module. That ack publishes NO event by design -- it is the END of the chain, not a new fact, and minting a consumer-less event is the very silent drop this registry exists to prevent. Until the ack lands the item reads as domain.VerdictStateApplying ('decided, not yet in effect') instead of vanishing out of the pending queue, so a stopped relay or dead-lettered verdict is visible rather than looking like completed work. Approval deliberately does NOT close the bucket: close is a separate WeighingMonitor leadership action (CloseScope) that approval merely UNBLOCKS via the close gate.

consumers.notes: verification.item.closed is POLYSEMOUS -- it carries both an operational closure and a WithdrawItemsBySource retraction -- so every consumer must read payload.status. handleGenericEvent filters Source.Module='vaccination' with a non-empty Source.SubmissionID (weighing withdrawals, the only producer of the 'withdrawn' variant today, never reach it) AND returns early on status='withdrawn', so a future vaccination supersede path cannot apply a verdict-shaped outcome with an empty actor to work that was taken back.

handleItemClosed branches on status: an operational closure notifies the OPERATOR that their record is done; a 'withdrawn' retraction instead routes handleItemWithdrawn to the park's module verify-duty holders -- the same audience verification.item.pending pushed to -- because they are the ones left holding a review request that no longer exists. afternoon feed correction packing reopen (maintainer decision 2026-08-29, extending the 2026-08-10 reopen rule): feeddirection.Repository.ReopenPackingForFeedChange emits ONE event per reopened completion, in the SAME transaction that flips the row back to 'rework', withdraws its pending verification item, and stores the session-specific old-vs-new reason (composed from the row's packed-against snapshot, migration 000222, plus the corrected sheet). Payload carries park/pen/session display labels, the packer (operator_id = completed_by), the packed-against numbers when snapshotted, the corrected numbers, and the stored reason -- so the push needs no lookup at consume time. Idempotency key is completion_id + the reopen's row_version: one completion reopened twice (reopen -> re-submit -> later correction) is two distinct facts, while a retried reopen collapses onto one message.

consumers.notes: DOWNWARD push to the packer whose video was taken back (ResolveMemberRecipients on operator_id), naming the park, pen, session, feed day, and the old-vs-new quantities -- the STG 2026-08-28 confusion was the card silently mutating with no explanation and no notification. No leadership leg: a head-count correction is routine daily work, not an escalation. An event with no operator_id (legacy row with blank completed_by) pushes nothing and logs.

Grain is the PEN-DAY (no session) and the workflow is constrained to 'experiment' -- the worklist is derived from the day's frozen experiment sheet. The payload carries wastage_kg only when the verifier recorded it before approving; absence means 'not yet measured', never zero.

PC Care operator submit: pccare.Repository.SubmitTask flips pc_care_tasks to pending_verification, stamps submitted animals, records audit/idempotency, and writes this transactional outbox event in the same commit. The durable consumer enqueues exactly one generic verification item keyed by task row_version for the four verifier-reviewed categories; an inventory_vaccine stock task is SKIPPED (maintainer decision 2026-09-02) because the PC Director judges it on the stock-verdict route, never the verifier.

consumers.notes: PCCarePendingVerificationHandler consumes pc_care.task.pending_verification and calls the PC Care verification bridge, which maps the task media set to verification.CreateItem idempotently. Director-approved categories (inventory_vaccine) are skipped here AND in the bridge: their approval is the pc_care stock-verdict HTTP route (pc_care.stock_approve), not a verification item.
